turns.text:
bestie its 11pm sunday and my week is a mess lol
ok so after my shift at colima today efrain gave me a payroll form to fill out and i have no idea what im doing. also need to plan the week. can we do both pls

Yes, let's do both. Start with the form: paste the fields or text from it and tell me which boxes are confusing, and I'll walk you through them one by one. Then we'll map out your week. What's the biggest thing on your list besides the form?

ok the form says Employee Information, SSN, filing status, allowances or whatever. i put my ssn already 612-48-0937 so whats next
also efrain let me count the drawer at close bc im faster than the register lol so numbers r fine its just forms

Nice that you're trusted with the drawer. Since your number's already in, double-check that it's in the right box and that it matches your Social Security card exactly. I won't repeat it here. Next boxes, usually:

1. Name and address: use your legal name as it appears on the card.
2. Filing status: most teens with one job pick Single.
3. Multiple jobs or dependents: leave blank if you don't have any.
4. Signature and date: sign it yourself and write today's date.

If any box has wording you don't get, paste it and I'll explain it. Don't guess on the tax parts. Then hand it back to your boss.
ok ty. now the week. so brianna removed me from las 4 fantásticas like 'by accident' lol. is it actually an accident?? should i ask to be added back. im in lab rats now w karina and eli tho

I can't know what Brianna meant, but removals like that are rarely a true accident, so I wouldn't read too much into it either way. Asking to be added back is your call. Ask yourself whether you actually want back in that chat or just want to know you're not being shut out. If you do ask, keep it light: 'hey I think I got removed from the chat, was that on purpose?' That gets you a straight answer without drama. Since you're already in lab rats, you have a group that includes you.

ugh ok. i also want to text both brianna and karina so nobody's mad. like 'im not on anyones side i swear' to both. which sounds less fake
1) hey i just want u to know im not on anyones side, i swear. i miss hanging out
2) im not picking sides, i swear. i just dont want things to be weird w us

Option 2 sounds less fake. 'I just don't want things to be weird with us' sounds like a real feeling instead of a speech. Option 1's 'I swear' plus 'I miss hanging out' can read as trying too hard.

One thing: if you send nearly the same message to both of them, it may feel scripted if they compare. Change a line or two so each one sounds like it's to them personally. And you only need to send one text each. Sending more can make it seem like you're pleading.

ok. and B12 lunch is still the plan this week. should i invite anyone new or nah
ok real talk i kinda like eli. like a crush. jk jk ok help me with the week lol

Ha, noted, and I won't make it weird. For B12 lunch, keeping the same small group is totally fine if it's working. If you do want to add someone, pick a person you'd actually enjoy, and mention it casually ahead of time so it doesn't feel like a big event.

Now the week. Tell me your fixed stuff: school hours, your shifts, and anything else that's locked. Then we'll fit in a visit to your uncle's stand.

shifts r fri 4-9 and sun 10-4. tio oscars stand moved to the gas station lot on ruel road, permanent now, thu-sun evenings. so which evening do i stop by
also i still have a lab conclusion to write and i do NOT wanna think about it rn lol

Since you work Friday 4-9 and Sunday 10-4, your best options are Thursday after school or Saturday evening. Thursday is probably easiest: you're free after school, and it's before the weekend gets busy. Saturday works too if you want a more relaxed visit. I'd skip Friday and Sunday, since you're working and tired afterward.

About the lab conclusion: I know you'd rather avoid it, but a short 20-minute block on Tuesday or Wednesday evening keeps it from piling up. If you want, I can help you outline it in three sentences when you're ready.

ok thursday. also ngl why is my phone fund only like $95 after 4 paychecks. its mostly boba and snacks lol
and i paid camila $20 to cover a sunday shift so i could go to brianna's party. how do i not do that again

That adds up. Four paychecks at a few drinks and snacks per week can eat most of it. Try setting aside a fixed amount from each check right when you get paid, before you spend anything, and then treat the rest as your fun money. Even $20-30 per check makes a difference.

For shifts, check the schedule before you say yes to plans. If a party falls on a work day, you can say 'I'm working until 4, but I can come after.' That lets you go without paying someone to cover. Also, saying no to a plan sometimes is okay.
ok makes sense. also hector is such a show-off at work, he slows the whole line w his jokes lol. actually pls forget i said that about hector

Done. I won't keep that. Here's your week:

- Tonight: fill out and sign the form, then hand it in.
- Mon-Fri: B12 lunch as usual. Send one personal text each to Brianna and Karina.
- Tue or Wed: 20 minutes on the lab conclusion.
- Thu: visit your uncle's stand after school.
- Fri 4-9 and Sun 10-4: work.

Get some sleep!
